name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strikes killed at least 15 people in the Kyiv region on 22–23 Nov, including 11 in a block of flats in Dymer
state: Russian attacks on the Kyiv region overnight into 23 Nov killed at least 15 people, per AFP: 11 in a five-storey building in Dymer, three at a supermarket in Vyshneve and one in Bila Tserkva, according to regional and local officials (A News). A power substation in Dnipropetrovsk was also hit. Overnight into 20 Nov Russia launched more than 100 missiles and about 400 drones, mostly at energy targets, per Ukraine's Air Force (Kyiv Post). Repeated mass-casualty strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure are increasing power cuts in Ukraine as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes: 15+ killed in Kyiv region 22–23 Nov = Alert
